scope: Independent one-study protein continued-training experiment, NOT full paper reproduction
preprocessing: Positive measured LFQ only; 51-bin per-profile quantiles before uniform subsampling; no missing targets or imputation
loss: Mean of masked expression-decoder and MVC MSE
limits: No RNA-only continued-training control; no single-cell evaluation; no original FlashAttention equivalence. Training dataset cannot be used as held-out protein evaluation.
